key_insight: Scaling humanoid behavior foundation models works best when motion tracking, diverse data collection, and a transformer architecture are designed together.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical recipe for building more accurate, generalizable humanoid control policies for both simulation and real-world deployment.
method: Recast control tasks as global-frame whole-body motion tracking.
Balance on-policy rollout volume with reference motion diversity.
Use a Humanoid Transformer to learn structured behavioral representations.
evidence_signal: Across simulation and real-world tests, the approach reduced test MPKPE by over 10% in local mode and 82% in global mode versus existing humanoid controllers.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on high-quality motion data and careful coordination of training, data diversity, and model scale.
paper_title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
